description: This file defines the NullMetadata class, implementing the Metadata interface for JSON null values within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.entity.metadata package. It provides methods to handle JSON null values, returning fixed responses or throwing exceptions as appropriate.

classes.name: NullMetadata
classes.description: Immutable class representing a JSON null value for Metadata interface, handling JSON nulls in the system.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static method to create a new instance of NullMetadata.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Returns false, as this represents a null value, not a boolean.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Returns false, as null does not represent a number.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this is not an integer.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this is not a long.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this is not a double.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Returns false, as this is null, not a string.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Returns true, as null is considered an object.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Returns false, indicating this is not an array.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Returns true, representing the null JSON value.

methods.name: asBoolean
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, as null cannot be converted to boolean.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, as null cannot be converted to int.

methods.name: asLong
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, as null cannot be converted to long.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, as null cannot be converted to double.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, as null cannot be converted to string.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns itself as an object representation.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, as null cannot be converted to array.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the JSON object and returns a new Metadata instance.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Overloaded methods to set fields using definitions or JsonField and return new Metadata instances.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple JsonFields and returns a new Metadata instance.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks presence of a key, always false for null.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves optional value for a key, always empty for null.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves nested JsonObject at given pointer or field selector, always returning self.

methods.name: getValueOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves value or throws if missing; always throws for null.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key, always returns self.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns empty list; null has no keys.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns empty Optional; null has no fields.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns empty iterator.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns true; null is empty.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns 0 for null.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns an empty stream of JsonFields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns the wrapped null object as JsonObject.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns JSON representation with given schema version and predicate, always the null object.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns JSON representation with given schema version and field selector, always the null object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Hash code based on the wrapped null object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the wrapped object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the wrapped null object.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the null value to the provided SerializationContext.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Returns upper bound size estimate for JSON null literal.
